title: Collect a granule sample with a spring-closed slide probe
instruction: Use the closing sampling probe to collect at least 5 grams of granules from the tub into the sample jar. Leave the probe supported, the sample contained, and both hands released.
context: A linear sampling probe admits granules while buried, closes to retain the sample, then reopens with its head inside the jar. This isolates an industrial incoming-material sampling operation.
setup: Calibrated bimanual YAM station, standard parallel grippers, table top z=0.7475 m, overview and two wrist cameras. Original 300 mm aluminum/polymer sampler: 280 g frame; 70 g shutter assembly; 54×54×54 mm chamber with sloped floor and 50 mm spring-return gate. Left support grasp (−10,70,255) mm; right 60×34×18 mm flat tab at (−50,−80,190) mm. Source: fixed polymer tub, 105×105 mm inside, 145 mm walls, 3 mm thick, floor reference (0.43,0.02,0.7475) m. Material: 1,960 separate 6.8 mm, 0.18 g polymer spheres, initially in a 14×14×10 lattice at 7.1 mm pitch, then settled. Jar: fixed polymer cup, 110×110 mm inside, 95 mm walls, 3 mm thick, floor reference (0.35,0.15,0.7475) m. Probe origin (0.43,0.38,0.7535) m; polymer cradle has 116×116×6 mm foot, 30 mm walls and a 100 mm opening. Secondary polymer tray: 520×620 mm inside, 50 mm walls, 8 mm base, centred at (0.40,0.16) m. Full station, custom solids, nominal materials, masses and transforms are in README.md, setup-layout.json and scene-inventory.json.
scoring: 0.4 for ≥2 g and <5 g eligible sample at rest in the jar; 0.7 for ≥5 g. A grain must enter the open front port from the source, remain enclosed after closure to ≤2 mm, then exit the reopened port. Holding a full head inside the jar gives no delivery credit. Full 1.0 additionally requires all corners of the 54 mm head inside the 100 mm cradle opening (+0.5 mm measurement tolerance), origin within 5 mm of support height, upright cosine >0.98, gate ≤2 mm open, probe speeds <15 mm/s and 0.15 rad/s, both grippers >40 mm open and all robot collision bodies >3 mm clear for 1 s. Granules below tabletop−5 mm, a probe outside the declared work area, or invalid numerical state permanently score 0. README.md defines source bounds and whole-grain membership.
reset_notes: Restore the fixed geometry and 1,960 individual grains, zero GateSlide, initialize standard READY/open grippers, then settle 2.5 seconds. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Original upright probe with a 54 mm chamber, sloped floor and passive spring-return 50 mm shutter. 1,960 individual 6.8 mm, 0.18 g polymer grains use native rigid contacts and continuous collision detection. A constant 25 N/m spring with 20 mm preload and gravity close the gate. Separated handles, a wide cradle and in-jar discharge are explicit fixture geometry. Manufacturer references motivate the operating principle; this is original geometry.
scores: Scripted native demo: 1.0, delivering 24.12 g in 2,257 actions (112.85 seconds). Matching Dream-1 run pending.
